bundle.shortDescription: Graphing calculator with a graph agent on your ChatGPT plan
bundle.longDescription: Equation.io is a free, open-source graphing calculator. The desktop app adds Sign in with ChatGPT, a graph agent that reads and edits your graph, and voice mode, all running on your own ChatGPT plan.
